mapper.select: select B.name_eng from users A inner join user_profile B on B.org_id = A.org_id and B.user_id = A.user_id where A.username = #{username}

select A.user_id, A.username, A.role, B.name_eng, A.is_enable, A.updated_by, A.updated_datetime from users A inner join user_profile B on B.org_id = A.org_id and B.user_id = A.user_id where A.updated_datetime >= NOW() - INTERVAL 3 MONTH
mapper.update: update users set is_enable = 0, updated_by = 'SYSTEM', updated_datetime = NOW() where role <> 'ROLE_ADMIN' and updated_datetime <= NOW() - INTERVAL 3 MONTH

update booking_appointment set user_id = 0, owner_id = 0, updated_by = ( select B.name_eng from users A inner join user_profile B on B.org_id = A.org_id and B.user_id = A.user_id where A.username = #{userNameEng} ), updated_datetime = NOW() where owner_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select A.id, A.user_id, A.username, A.role, B.name_eng, A.is_enable, A.updated_by, A.updated_datetime from users A inner join user_profile B on B.org_id = A.org_id and B.user_id = A.user_id where A.user_id = #{userId} and ( A.role <> #{role} or A.is_enable <> #{isEnable} ) and ( exists( select user_id from users where is_enable = 1 and role = 'ROLE_ADMIN' and username = #{userNameEng} ) )
mapper.update: update users set role = #{role}, is_enable = #{isEnable}, updated_by = ( select C.name_eng from ( select B.name_eng from users A inner join user_profile B on B.org_id = A.org_id and B.user_id = A.user_id where A.username = #{userNameEng} ) C ), updated_datetime = NOW() where user_id = #{userId} and ( exists( select D.user_id from ( select user_id from users where is_enable = 1 and role = 'ROLE_ADMIN' and username = #{userNameEng} ) D ) )
